items.title: Indian shares snap losing run led by IT, financials as bond markets steady
items.description: Indian shares ended a losing streak on Thursday. Nifty 50 rose 0.64% to 24,231.85 and Sensex gained 0.82% to 77,537.72, helped by IT and financial stocks and steadier global bond markets.

items.title: India regulator bets on trading reforms to reverse foreign capital flight
items.description: SEBI is preparing reforms intended to improve market access and address concerns from institutional investors as foreign ownership of Indian stocks reaches a 17-year low.

items.title: Global shocks, IPO wave could temper India's earnings-led market revival
items.description: Abakkus Investment Managers sees strong domestic earnings but warns that crude prices, global yields, AI-related volatility and heavy IPO activity could limit a broader market rally.

items.title: Rupee spins wheels in thin band, shorts await fresh entry points
items.description: The rupee remained in a narrow range while Brent crude rose above $93, keeping inflation and energy-import risks important for Indian markets.

items.title: Why did market rise today? Sensex rallies 628 points, Nifty closes above 23,230
items.description: The market rebound was attributed to lower US bond yields, rupee appreciation, short covering, renewed FII buying and positive global cues.
